definitions.short: Malcam or Milcom , the national idol of the Ammonites
definitions.full: H4445. Malkam מַלְכָּם proper name, masculine a Benjamite 1Chr 8:9 . ᵐ5 B Μελχας , A Μελχαμ , ᵐ5 L Μελχομ . On Jer 49:1 , 3 ; Zeph 1:5 see מִלְכֹּם . מִלְכֹּם proper name, of a divinity Milcom, god of Ammonites (compare RS Semitic i. 67 ) — ׳מ עַמֹּנִים שִׁקֻּץ 1Kin 11:5 (|| עַשְׁתֹּרֶת ); compare ׳מ עַמּוֺן בְנֵי אֱלֹהֵי 11:33 (|| ׳ע + כְּמוֺשׁ ), so read also (for מֹלֶךְ ᵑ0 ) 11:7 (|| כְּמוֺשׁ ); בְּנֵיעַֿמּוֺן ׳מ תּוֺעֲבַת 2Kin 23:13 (|| as 1Kin 11:33 ); read מִלְכֹּם also for מַלְכָּם Jer 49:1 , 3 ( ᵐ5 Μελχολ , Μελχομ ), compare Gie, and Zeph 1:5 ( ᵑ9 ᵑ6 , compare Now), probably 2Sam 12:30 = 1Chr 20:2 (see מֶלֶךְ 5d ), and perhaps Amos 1:15 (whence Jer 49:3 ; compare Dr Now; — not We GASm).
